parsed.reason: Perfect weekday_care message for a French parent (tu form). Opens with "journée pédagogique" word for word as required. Short, warm, first person ("Je peux chercher"). Says it "arrives" (is coming up), offers to find something nearby without naming anything specific. One question at the end ("ça t'intéresse?") with proper question mark. Real accent on "ça". No date, time, activity, place, or price mentioned. No hype, emoji, or corporate tone. Reads like a friend texting one parent.
